feminine nominative plural pronoun, referring back to the lotuses/states; L1/L2 context
eva + anyonya-ātmaka-bheda-avacchedana + ā-jihāsutayā (instrumental of desire to abandon); L1/L2: transcendence of mutual distinctions in the ascent
